assumptions.lift_extension_permission: Owner considers 644 x 1444 mm excessive; expanded lift footprint is not accepted. Current rotor layouts remain comparison evidence while compact layout and mass reduction are investigated.
assumptions.dusting_target: Owner reports ceiling fans about 7 ft (2133.6 mm) above floor and 1 ft (304.8 mm) below ceiling; about 2 ft (609.6 mm) duster reach is desired. Reach datum and fan blade geometry remain to detail. Earlier 2 m / 300 mm shelf assumption is superseded.
assumptions.purchase_policy: No new purchases or print release from this paper design.
assumptions.mass_ranges: Low/nominal/high engineering allowances, not confidence intervals. All combinations include only one bottom and one top.
assumptions.guard_factor: 0.75 baseline retained thrust at equal electrical operating point; sensitivity 0.65–0.85. Not measured guard performance.
assumptions.flight_voltage: 21 V under-load screening case; scaled maximum thrust is an estimate, not manufacturer low-voltage data.
assumptions.battery_exchange: Owner requires automatic cartridge exchange and charged station spares. Initial allocation: two spare packs and four rack bays per floor; one pack carried, five packs across two floors. Counts are design assumptions, not purchases or a no-wait guarantee.

lift.notes: Non-coaxial layout keeps the propeller disks clear of the core. Eight motors require a geometry-specific allocator; this is not a stock Octo-X frame. Existing 8S pack cannot power this 4–6S motor reference. The default identifies the previous accounting comparison, not a selected production top. Its long two-column arrangement is not a minimum-size proof.

station.notes: Five complete-bottom positions: local tool inventory plus receiving vacancy. Intact rotor top parks overhead. Station stock, water and machinery are not carried. Four battery bays hold two resident spares, one returning-pack vacancy and one recovery vacancy. Spare packs are excluded from carried robot mass. Cabinet/top storage dimensions inherit the oversized lift comparison and must be reconsidered with its replacement; they are not an accepted household footprint.

rows.mass_basis: Bounded design contents

screen.scope: Estimated installed thrust/power using published 24 V bench data and declared loss/voltage assumptions. Not a flight capability claim. Full-throttle curve point has a 29-second limit.

design_6s.scope: Bare pack versus the smaller cell pocket inside the cartridge. This excludes leads, padding and swelling clearance; it does not qualify an installed cartridge.

design_8s.scope: Bare pack versus the smaller cell pocket inside the cartridge. This excludes leads, padding and swelling clearance; it does not qualify an installed cartridge.

extension.scope: Smooth-duct estimate at assumed flow; excludes filter/head losses and seal leakage. Does not establish an operating point.

station.scope: Water/docking intervals are design recipes, not demonstrated sanitation or coverage. Mains evacuation is separate from the 24 V DC supply.

battery_exchange.scope: Energy throughput and pack-count screens only. Recovery scenarios must include cooling, shared-power contention, CC/CV taper and balance time. Swap time, connector fit, thermal containment and full gantry swept volume are unverified.

open_gates: Automatic battery exchange is required. Cartridge contacts/retention, cell monitoring, no-break dock logic power and independently supervised rack charging need electrical/mechanical detail; extra packs are not a no-wait guarantee.

Both battery packs remain comparisons. The 8S bare body fits only after rotating it onto its 47 mm side; installed restraint/lead clearance is unverified. It exceeds the selected lift motor voltage; do not substitute it in that propulsion curve.

TriCut stationary restraint, drive end, safe speed and cutter loading are not public dimensions. The cassette and drive are sized, but the interface insert needs the supplied brush or a supplier drawing.
Actual filter body/seal and clean/loaded pressure drop are unavailable. The maximum element allocation is not a measured filter.
Guard losses, hot/low-voltage motor performance, airflow near stairs and dynamic pet avoidance are unqualified. Current sizing results are screening cases.
Cell protection, regenerative clamp and automatic mating power contacts need schematic/PCB/thermal validation; IC/connector families are not finished subsystems.
The guided push strip, printed sliding air seals and telescope retrieval force need mechanical qualification; the reach calculation does not prove jam-free deployment.
Distributed frame/fastener/wiring mass is included, but production frame geometry and complete stress/creep checks are not finished.

Owner considers 644 x 1444 mm excessive: reopen lift packing and mass. Ceiling-fan target is now 2134 mm high, 305 mm below ceiling, with about 610 mm tool reach; current horizontal dust geometry does not implement fan access.
Autonomous station motions, floor navigation and flight estimators are specified as hardware/control contracts; no claim of implemented autonomy.
